mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, deal_id, document_id, policy_id, policy_id_snapshot, policy_binding, status, mode, separation_of_duties, outcome_reason, outcome_detail, requested_by, request_comment, decided_by, decision_comment, decided_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM document_approval WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT FROM document_approval WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND document_id = #{documentId} AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM document_approval WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND policy_id = #{policyId} AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY document_id, id
SELECT id FROM document_approval WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND policy_id = #{policyId} AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY id

SELECT d.id AS dealId, d.name AS dealName, dd.id AS documentId, dd.title AS documentTitle, dd.version, a.requested_by AS requestedBy, a.created_at AS requestedAt FROM document_approval a JOIN deal d ON d.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND d.id = a.deal_id JOIN deal_document dd ON dd.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND dd.deal_id = a.deal_id AND dd.id = a.document_id WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.policy_id = #{policyId} AND a.status = 'pending' ORDER BY a.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM document_approval WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document_approval WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND policy_id = #{policyId} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.update: UPDATE document_approval SET status = #{status}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decision_comment = #{decisionComment}, outcome_reason = #{outcomeReason}, outcome_detail = #{outcomeDetail}, decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.workspace_id, s.approval_id, s.step_order, s.name, s.required_count, s.status, s.decided_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at, a.id AS approver_id, a.workspace_id AS approver_workspace_id, a.step_id AS approver_step_id, a.approver_kind, a.user_id AS approver_user_id FROM document_approval_step s LEFT JOIN document_approval_step_approver a ON a.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND a.step_id = s.id WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.approval_id IN #{approvalId} ORDER BY s.approval_id, s.step_order, s.id, a.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_approval_step_approver (workspace_id, step_id, approver_kind, user_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{stepId}, #{approverKind}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE document_approval_step SET status = #{status}, decided_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('approved', 'rejected', 'cancelled', 'unsatisfiable') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
UPDATE document_approval_step SET status = 'cancelled', decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND approval_id = #{approvalId} AND status IN ('pending', 'active')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document_approval_decision WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND step_id = #{stepId} AND decision = 'approved'
